name: Mohamed Waleed Ezzat
headline: AI/ML Engineer — Agentic AI & LLM Systems
summary: AI/ML Engineer focused on Agentic AI: multi-agent orchestration, autonomous tool-calling systems, and production LLM-powered copilots deployed via FastAPI. Built a multi-agent pipeline for Recovera (planner, SQL generator, validator, executor, analytics interpreter) and an autonomous assistant that selects between tools based on user intent and streams its reasoning in real time. Experienced across the model lifecycle — training, evaluation, and deployment — and comfortable integrating LLM APIs (OpenRouter, Groq, Hugging Face) into scalable, production systems.

bullets: Delivered end-to-end AI-powered products for multiple clients without an in-house engineering team, by owning the full delivery cycle — requirements gathering, architecture selection, LLM integration, and deployment — across Python/FastAPI backends and React/Next.js frontends.

Reduced client dependency on manual processes by independently architecting and shipping production-ready agent logic and LLM API integrations, iterating based on direct client feedback as the sole developer on each engagement.

experience.company: Information Technology Institute (ITI), Menofia Branch, Egypt
bullets: Improved data readiness for forecasting by building automated ETL pipelines (SQL, Power Query) that transformed raw source data into clean, model-ready datasets, then prototyped deep learning forecasting models in PyTorch on top of them.

projects.name: Vector — AI Personal Assistant (Agentic AI)
projects.tech: Python, FastAPI, React, LangChain, PostgreSQL, Docker
bullets: Increased task-completion flexibility by architecting an autonomous agent with custom tool-calling logic that dynamically selected among web search, document analysis, image generation, and utility tools based on user intent.

Improved user trust and transparency by streaming the agent's step-by-step reasoning in real time via Server-Sent Events (SSE), and sustained coherent long-context conversations through a custom hybrid conversational memory system.

projects.name: Recovera — Multi-Agent AI and BI Copilot
bullets: Enabled non-technical users to query business data safely by architecting a production multi-agent orchestration pipeline (planner, SQL generator, validator, executor, analytics interpreter) that converted natural-language questions into validated analytics output.

Improved retrieval relevance for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) by integrating LLM APIs through the Hugging Face Transformers ecosystem for intelligent routing and semantic retrieval, backed by a PostgreSQL + pgvector embeddings schema.

Prevented unsafe or unauthorized query execution at scale by building a code-layer SQL validator (sqlglot + policy engine); deployed end-to-end (Hugging Face Spaces, Vercel) with LangSmith tracing for full multi-agent observability.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Transformer from Scratch
bullets: Built first-principles understanding of the architecture underlying modern LLM agents by engineering a GPT-2-style transformer from scratch in PyTorch — implementing custom training loops, tokenization, embeddings, multi-head self-attention, and transformer blocks.

projects.name: Advanced RAG Pipeline
bullets: Reduced hallucination risk and improved answer traceability by designing an end-to-end RAG pipeline covering chunking, embeddings, semantic retrieval, and context-aware generation with source citations.
